title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-0tde: lichen-schc crate has 57 compilation errors -- missing constants and undefined variables
description:
The lichen-schc crate does not compile at HEAD (137da91). 57 errors including:

1. Missing constant definitions: TILE_SIZE, BITMAP_MASK, WINDOW_SIZE, MAX_PACKET_SIZE, RULE_ID_A_TO_B, RULE_ID_B_TO_A — used extensively throughout fragment.rs but never defined or imported.

2. Undefined variables in Ack::write_to (fragment.rs:259-260): `n` and `body_bytes` are used but not in scope, making the non-complete ACK encoding path unreachable/corrupt.

3. Type mismatch: self.attempts (u8) compared against MAX_ACK_REQUESTS (u32) at lines 556, 573, 943.

4. Missing Debug impl for FragmentSender (needed by RetransmitIter derive).

5. headers.rs: write_ipv6_header now takes (u8, u32) tuple for flow, but 4 call sites still pass traffic_class and flow_label as separate args.

6. match statement at fragment.rs:84 uses RULE_ID_A_TO_B | RULE_ID_B_TO_A as patterns that are shadowed by ident bindings (E0408).

These are pre-existing issues not introduced by the current commit, but the commit does not fix them.
